definitions.gloss: Buddhist monk, Buddhist priest, clergy member
definitions.explanation: A person who has taken religious vows in Buddhism and serves as a member of the clergy. A formal term for Buddhist monks and priests.

examples.japanese: {僧侶|そうりょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦お{経|きょう}→お経：17854_okyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
⟦{葬式|そうしき}→葬式：04389_soushiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{僧侶|そうりょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{経|きょう}→お経：17854_okyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げて→上げる：02443_ageru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: We had a monk chant sutras at the funeral.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十人|じゅうにん}→十人：28475_juunin⟧ほど⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{僧侶|そうりょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}→修行：05522_shugyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{暮|く}らしている→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: About ten monks live at this temple for religious training.

notes:
A formal term. In everyday speech, お{坊|ぼう}さん is more commonly used. In Japan, Buddhist {僧侶|そうりょ} are often called upon for funerals, memorial services, and other religious ceremonies. Unlike in some other Buddhist traditions, Japanese monks are generally allowed to marry.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {僧侶|そうりょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{招|まね}く→招く：02425_maneku⟧ (invite a monk)
- {僧侶|そうりょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦お{経|きょう}→お経：17854_okyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (a monk reads sutras)
- {僧侶|そうりょ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}する→修行する：25391_shugyousuru⟧ (train as a monk)
